<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD file is being evaluated specifically for safety during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, which sources the file and executes only top-level code (not functions). The top-level scope contains only standard variable assignments: pkgname, pkgver, pkgrel, pkgdesc, arch, url, license, depends, optdepends, source, and sha256sums. These are conventional metadata definitions expected in any PKGBUILD.

The source URL points to the package's own declared upstream repository on GitHub (https://github.com/broroeror/ambience), which is consistent with the url field. The sha256sum is a real checksum (not SKIP), and the source entry uses standard tarball format. No command substitutions, downloads, or network requests occur at the top level. The `package()` function is defined but not executed during `--printsrcinfo`, so its contents are out of scope for this gate.
</details>
<evidence>
</evidence>
<summary>
Top-level PKGBUILD is standard; no executable code at global scope.</summary>
</security_assessment>
